title: sec.quarantine.v1
description: Phase 7 §7.1/§7.2: forensic capture of a payload the defense pipeline rejected. `storage.v1` is the SOLE consumer (persists to `quarantine_samples`, migration 007). `raw_bytes_b64` is base64 of the raw payload bytes capped at `cfg.sec_quarantine_payload_max_bytes` BEFORE encoding. `pii_redacted=true` indicates the producer already stripped a sensitive field (e.g. the auth password buffer per §7.1). Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::QuarantineSample`.

pii_redacted.description: Producer already stripped a known sensitive field (auth `password` etc.).

bytes_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the raw payload bytes (matches `sec.alert.v1.evidence_ref`).
